name: When should I start thinking about fixture selections for my project?

mainEntity.name: When should I start thinking about fixture selections for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should start thinking about fixture selections early in the design phase of your project. Early selection allows ample time for ordering, accounting for potential lead times, and coordinating with the overall construction schedule. For a project with Frasheski Construction, discussing your fixture preferences during initial planning helps us integrate them seamlessly into the design and budget, preventing delays later on. This preparation is key to a smooth installation process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin fixture selections early in the design phase to allow for ordering lead times and seamless integration into the project schedule.
